# DevDrop (https://devdrop.online)

> DevDrop is an open-access web utility, cybersecurity diagnostic, and open-source HTML5 browser games platform featuring 88 diagnostic tools and 24 curated open-source web games. All tools and games execute client-side in the browser with zero server tracking and zero software downloads.

## Platform Overview
- Canonical Domain: https://devdrop.online
- Games Directory: https://devdrop.online/games
- Tools Directory: https://devdrop.online/tools
- Sitemap: https://devdrop.online/sitemap.xml
- Total Diagnostic Tools: 88
- Total Open Source Games: 24
- Game Technologies: HTML5 Canvas, WebGL, WebAssembly, TypeScript, JavaScript
- Primary Sources: GitHub (bobeff/open-source-games & verified open-source contributors)
- Privacy Policy: No cookies, no server tracking, 100% in-browser processing

## Diagnostic Tools Catalog by Category

### Wi-Fi & Network Security
802.11 beacon sniffers, WPA handshake crackers, signal radars, router admin gateways, and packet attack simulators.

- [Wi-Fi Network Penetration Suite](https://devdrop.online/tools/wifi-hacker-engine): Simulate wireless monitor mode, beacon frame injection, and 4-way EAPOL handshake interception across local networks.
- [Wi-Fi WPA Key Decryption Engine](https://devdrop.online/tools/wifi-password-cracker): Simulate GPU-accelerated hashcat wordlist attacks and WPS PIN entropy testing on wireless access points.
- [Wi-Fi Spectrum Frequency Radar](https://devdrop.online/tools/wifi-radar): Visualize wireless signal density, channel overlap, and RF attenuation across 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz frequency bands.
- [Router Gateway Admin Exploit Console](https://devdrop.online/tools/router-admin-tool): Simulate administrative gateway credential exploitation and BusyBox Linux kernel shell penetration.
- [Network Subnet Port Scanner](https://devdrop.online/tools/network-scanner): Discover open ports, services, and live network nodes using live SYN packet probes across a /24 subnet.
- [Connected LAN Device Explorer](https://devdrop.online/tools/connected-devices): Inspect local subnet nodes and uncover live unauthorized devices, smart TVs, and IoT hardware on your network.
- [Wi-Fi Multi-Stream Throughput Benchmark](https://devdrop.online/tools/wifi-speed-test): Benchmark live internet bandwidth, multi-stream downlink throughput, uplink capacity, and bufferbloat latency.
- [Volumetric Network Stress Tester](https://devdrop.online/tools/network-attack): Simulate massive volumetric DDoS attacks, SYN flood packet surges, and firewall mitigation thresholds.
